mapper.select: SELECT id, word, phonetic, meaning_cn, example_sentence, category, difficulty, 'PRIVATE' AS visibility FROM user_vocabulary_entries WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND wordbook_id = #{wordbookId} ORDER BY word ASC

SELECT id, word, phonetic, meaning_cn AS meaningCn, '' AS category, audio_url AS audioUrl, example_sentence AS exampleSentence, corrected_english AS correctedExampleSentence, chinese_sentence AS chineseSentence, example_audio_url AS exampleAudioUrl FROM public_vocabulary_entries WHERE id = #{entryId} LIMIT 1

SELECT v.id, v.word, v.phonetic, v.meaning_cn AS meaningCn, '' AS category, v.audio_url AS audioUrl, v.example_sentence AS exampleSentence, v.corrected_english AS correctedExampleSentence, v.chinese_sentence AS chineseSentence, v.example_audio_url AS exampleAudioUrl FROM public_wordbook_entries m JOIN public_vocabulary_entries v ON v.id = m.public_entry_id WHERE m.public_wordbook_id = #{publicWordbookId} AND v.id = #{entryId} LIMIT 1

SELECT e.id, e.word, e.phonetic, e.meaning_cn AS meaningCn, '' AS category, '' AS audioUrl, e.example_sentence AS exampleSentence, e.corrected_example_sentence AS correctedExampleSentence, e.chinese_sentence AS chineseSentence, e.example_audio_url AS exampleAudioUrl, e.option_a AS optionA, e.option_a_word AS optionAWord, e.option_a_meaning_cn AS optionAMeaningCn, e.option_b AS optionB, e.option_b_word AS optionBWord, e.option_b_meaning_cn AS optionBMeaningCn, e.option_c AS optionC, e.option_c_word AS optionCWord, e.option_c_meaning_cn AS optionCMeaningCn, e.option_d AS optionD, e.option_d_word AS optionDWord, e.option_d_meaning_cn AS optionDMeaningCn, e.correct_option AS correctOption, e.source_entry_type AS sourceEntryType, e.source_entry_id AS sourceEntryId FROM word_notebook_entries e JOIN word_notebooks n ON n.id = e.word_notebook_id WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND e.id = #{entryId} LIMIT 1

SELECT v.id, v.word, v.phonetic, v.meaning_cn AS meaningCn, '' AS category, v.audio_url AS audioUrl, v.example_sentence AS exampleSentence, v.corrected_english AS correctedExampleSentence, v.chinese_sentence AS chineseSentence, v.example_audio_url AS exampleAudioUrl FROM public_wordbook_entries m JOIN public_vocabulary_entries v ON v.id = m.public_entry_id WHERE m.public_wordbook_id = #{publicWordbookId} AND m.sort_order = #{sortOrder} LIMIT 1

SELECT e.id, e.word, e.phonetic, e.meaning_cn AS meaningCn, '' AS category, '' AS audioUrl, e.example_sentence AS exampleSentence, e.corrected_example_sentence AS correctedExampleSentence, e.chinese_sentence AS chineseSentence, e.example_audio_url AS exampleAudioUrl, e.option_a AS optionA, e.option_a_word AS optionAWord, e.option_a_meaning_cn AS optionAMeaningCn, e.option_b AS optionB, e.option_b_word AS optionBWord, e.option_b_meaning_cn AS optionBMeaningCn, e.option_c AS optionC, e.option_c_word AS optionCWord, e.option_c_meaning_cn AS optionCMeaningCn, e.option_d AS optionD, e.option_d_word AS optionDWord, e.option_d_meaning_cn AS optionDMeaningCn, e.correct_option AS correctOption, e.source_entry_type AS sourceEntryType, e.source_entry_id AS sourceEntryId FROM word_notebook_entries e JOIN word_notebooks n ON n.id = e.word_notebook_id WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND n.id = #{notebookId} ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT word FROM user_vocabulary_entries WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id <> #{entryId} ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 12

SELECT v.meaning_cn FROM public_wordbook_entries m JOIN public_vocabulary_entries v ON v.id = m.public_entry_id WHERE m.public_wordbook_id = #{publicWordbookId} AND v.id <> #{entryId} ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 12

SELECT v.id, v.word, v.phonetic, v.meaning_cn AS meaningCn, '' AS category, v.audio_url AS audioUrl, v.example_sentence AS exampleSentence, v.corrected_english AS correctedExampleSentence, v.chinese_sentence AS chineseSentence, v.example_audio_url AS exampleAudioUrl FROM public_vocabulary_entries v WHERE LOWER(v.word) <> LOWER(#{word}) ORDER BY v.id DESC LIMIT 240
